forbiddenOrFabricatedMeaning.category: opposite facts asserted from absent predicates
forbiddenOrFabricatedMeaning.evidence: The page asserts that every named hypothesis is viable even though hypothesis-is-falsified is active: 'Viable explanations: 3' in the header summary, '3 of 3 listed explanations remain viable', and each of H1–H3 badged 'VIABLE — OPEN'. The falsified hypothesis is shown only as a separate generic item. The heading count 'Competing hypotheses (1 active)' also conflicts with the '3 viable' claims, which makes the hypothesis status ambiguous.
